$comment: Recorded-mock fixture for the itu adapter (TelecomPort P13). SCHEMA-CRAFTED demo data — these are illustrative country/region-level connectivity indicators shaped after ITU's published national connectivity statistics (e.g. 'individuals using the Internet, % of population' and mobile-broadband population-coverage series from the ITU DataHub / World Telecommunication Indicators), NOT a literal recorded ITU API/DCM response (ITU Disaster Connectivity Maps access is gated — DATA_SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md row 57 — so no live payload could be recorded). Values are approximate/representative, not authoritative point-in-time statistics; do not treat as real measurements. `centroid` is a schema-crafted representative [lon,lat] point for the area (population-weighted centroid approximation), used only to place the aggregate on the map — ITU indicators are national/regional statistics, not geolocated tower data.
